title: MAP: FinSys pilot integration & target close (needs reforecast)
text:
MAP: FinSys pilot integration & target close (needs reforecast)

['From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@finsys.com>, Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:30:00 -0500
Subject: MAP draft & next steps following today’s discovery

Hi Olivia / Jacob,

Thanks again for the call earlier — great discussion and helpful context on priorities. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the FinSys pilot that reflects the milestones we talked through: pilot scope sign-off, data onboarding, SAML integration, preflight tests, and pilot go-live.

High level (proposed):
- Target pilot close: 2026-03-31 (pilot complete + internal sign-off)
- Owner: FinSys owns procurement & production data access; Redwood owns model infra, SAML config, and runbook
- Key dependencies: procurement cadence, security questionnaire completion (SOC2 items), SAML metadata exchange

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached MAP (FinSys_MAP_DRAFT_20260210.xlsx) and flag any timeline conflicts or missing items.
2) If procurement or legal expect a different close window, let us know and we’ll reforecast.
3) We’ll send a revised MAP (v2) after your feedback — target by next Wednesday (2026-02-17).

Attachments: FinSys_MAP_DRAFT_20260210.xlsx (MAP with milestones/responsibilities)

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | 650-555-0142

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
', 'From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@finsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finsys.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps following today’s discovery

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP. Jacob and I reviewed this with procurement and security this morning. A couple of updates from our side that will impact the timeline: 

- Procurement has a vendor review slot pushed to mid-March due to an internal audit; earliest we can complete contracting is now the week of 2026-04-05.
- Security wants one additional artifact: a signed data-retention policy statement and an internal contact for audit requests (we can provide our template if helpful).

Given the procurement shift, can you reforecast the MAP so target pilot close is moved to mid-April? Specifically, we’d like milestones reprioritized so critical integration work (SAML + data model validation) is front-loaded and the optional reporting enhancements are later in the queue.

Also — we would appreciate an abbreviated executive summary to share with our procurement stakeholders that highlights the business outcomes, expected costs, and SLA commitments (very short, one page). Can you have the updated MAP and exec summary to us by 2026-02-20?

Thanks,
Olivia

On Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 3:30 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message and attachment]
', 'From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: FW: MAP draft & next steps following today’s discovery

Marissa / Laura — fyi from FinSys: procurement moved the vendor review and they want the MAP reprioritized and reforecasted with a new target in mid-April. Requested delivery for updated MAP + 1-page exec summary is 2026-02-20.

Quick asks: 
- Laura: can we front-load SAML integration and data model validation milestones (move them earlier) and indicate any blockers that would prevent an April 15 pilot close? Please include estimated engineering effort and whether we’ll need dedicated Redwood engineering time during the pilot ramp.
- Marissa: pricing/contract note — if procurement pushes contract sign to 2026-04-05, we should plan for a small eligibility window for promo pricing; will you draft two pricing rows (standard vs. delayed-signing) so Olivia can show options to procurement?

I’ll draft MAP_v2 and the exec summary once I have your inputs — target tomorrow EOD.

Thanks — looping Laura on technical details.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
', 'From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FW: MAP draft & next steps following today’s discovery

Karthik / Marissa — thanks, quick technical notes and recommended MAP changes.

- SAML: we can complete SAML configuration and basic end-to-end validation in ~8 engineering days (2 engineers, non-concurrent work). Dependencies: FinSys needs to provide SAML metadata and a test IdP by 2026-03-10 to hit an April 15 pilot. If metadata is later than that, the close will slip.
- Data model validation: recommend two-week window for initial schema validation + sample data load (validate schema, small sample runs). Need FinSys to provide sanitized sample export and data retention contact by 2026-03-01.
- Preflight tests / perf: schedule 3 days of smoke tests and 2 days of load validation; these require access to a dedicated staging environment the week prior to go-live.

I attached a short integration test plan to show the earliest feasible sequencing and call out hard blockers. If we sequence SAML (week 1–2) + data validation (week 2–4) + perf tests (week 5), April 15 remains feasible provided procurement signs by 2026-04-05 and the metadata deadlines above are met.

Attachments: integration_test_plan_20260217.pdf

--
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
', 'From: Jacob Lee <jacob.lee@finsys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@finsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP draft & next steps following today’s discovery

Karthik / Laura — thanks for the breakdown and the test plan. That sequencing makes sense. Per procurement’s new timeline, we can commit to a signing target of the week of 2026-04-05. With the deadlines Laura outlined we’ll aim to get you SAML metadata by 2026-03-10 and a sanitized sample export by 2026-03-01.

Two items from our side:
- We’ll need the one-page exec summary for procurement (they want simple bullet points on outcomes and the two pricing options).
- Please include a row in the MAP that explicitly lists the contingency plan if SAML metadata is delayed (i.e., move to token-based auth for pilot with a known delta to production).

I’ve penciled a follow-up sync for Wed, 2026-02-25 at 10:00am ET — Olivia will send a calendar invite. If you can get MAP_v2 and the exec summary to us by EOD 2026-02-20 that would be great.

Thanks — we’ll review when received.

--
Jacob Lee
Director, Product Partnerships, FinSys
jacob.lee@finsys.com
